nodes.title: Consistence Lora
widgets_values:
Occasionally, you may want to apply the consistency LoRA to preserve the character's consistency that already exists in the image. This is particularly useful when positioning the reference character alongside another character. 
For example: "They are taking a selfie side by side" 
A strength setting of 0.25–0.3 typically yields good results. 

If you're only replacing the head, set the strength to 0.

https://civitai.com/models/1939453?modelVersionId=2634354

If the output shows the reference image instead of the swapped face, it means the model didn't detect a face in the picture—possibly due to partial coverage, an unusual angle, or the face being too small or too large.

Load your images here. Once the images are processed and the model runs, they'll automatically populate the Olm Drag Crop nodes—unless bypassed. 
I recommend at least one full-sized high quality crop of the face, as details may get lost due to VAE downsampling and faces may come out blurry if the face is too small.
